tools.name: log_costs
tools.description: Log what your agent's model and tool calls cost, then get the running total for the run and for today. Pass events (one per call, up to 500) or an OpenTelemetry OTLP/JSON trace export as otel (gen_ai.usage.input_tokens / output_tokens / gen_ai.request.model are read; trace id becomes run_id). Give c

tools.name: cost_report
tools.description: Cost per run, per tool, per model and per day. Without an API key pass run_id (one run). With a key: everything on that key. Free shows 7 days, Pro 30.

tools.name: weekly_report
tools.description: Plain-English summary of the last 7 days of spend: total, top runs, top tools, top models, busiest day. Read-only; sends nothing. Needs a free API key.

tools.name: usage_and_upgrade
tools.description: Show today's usage for your key or IP and the $9/month upgrade link. Free tier: 500 calls/day. Not metered.
